title: TrackState
description: One mixer track. Returned by add_track / get_tracks / set_track_* commands and embedded in project.json. Mirrors Rust struct audio::TrackState.

id.description: Track UUIDv4 (stable for the life of the project).

kind.description: Track type. "automation" holds clips that drive bindings and takes no mixer slot.

gainDb.description: Fader gain in decibels relative to unity. -160.0 encodes -infinity (silence). Typical UI range -60..+12.

pan.description: Stereo pan: -1.0 = hard left, 0.0 = center, 1.0 = hard right.

muted.description: Track is muted (excluded from the mix unless soloed elsewhere logic applies).

soloed.description: Track is soloed (when any track is soloed, only soloed tracks are audible).

armed.description: Track is record-armed; start_recording captures onto armed tracks.

color.description: UI accent color as lowercase hex "#rrggbb".

group.description: Lane group this track displays under, as the group's own name. Absent or null = ungrouped. Display grouping only — the mixer graph and slot numbering ignore it. Additive (lanes UX); pre-lanes projects omit it.

inserts.description: Ordered insert-FX slots. Slot id is a stable UUID; instanceId names a PluginInstanceInfo.id. Absent means empty.
